answer: In the simple logistic regression of camrelizumab treatment response (Efficacy: PR = 1, PD/SD = 0; n = 80, 41 events) on raw Age, the coefficient estimate for Age is −0.074954 — i.e., a change of ≈ −0.075 in the log-odds of response per 1-year increase in age (SE 0.024351, z = −3.078, p = 0.00208; odds ratio per year ≈ 0.928; intercept 4.4466; nobs = 80; log-likelihood = −50.071). Secondary checks: standardised-age coefficient ≈ −0.7839 (per 1-SD, SD = 10.459), and using Groups(1/2) as the outcome reproduces the identical coefficient (−0.074954).
